tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Commodity Brokerage Token
description: Stock Brokers Ltd provides retail brokerage access to warehouse receipt tokens from Oman's certified storage facilities. Anyone with a mobile phone can buy fractions of a warehouse receipt backed by stored grain, coffee, groundnuts or cotton. Supports farmers and attracts commodity investment.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Service Contract Investment Token
description: Through Stock Brokers Ltd, retail investors access pools of verified service contracts from Oman's informal sector. By investing in a bundle of 1,000 plumber, electrician and caterer contracts, an ordinary saver earns returns while funding livelihood improvement for service workers. Minimum investment is one currency unit.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Infrastructure PPP Brokerage Token
description: Stock Brokers Ltd brings government PPP infrastructure projects to retail investors in Oman. Road, bridge and school construction tokens are available for purchase from small amounts, with returns from government revenue-sharing agreements. Each project creates hundreds of local construction and maintenance jobs.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Fractional Property Token
underlyingAsset: Fractional property access for all — Oman
description: Stock Brokers Ltd makes property investment available to every Oman citizen through fractional real estate tokens. A domestic worker earning minimum wage can invest monthly savings into property portfolios via Stock Brokers Ltd's platform. Returns from rental income and property appreciation are distributed quarterly to all holders.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Labor Impact Token
underlyingAsset: Retail access to labor proof-of-work investments — Oman
description: Through Stock Brokers Ltd, impact investors in Oman can directly invest in verified labor tokens from informal sector workers. Each investment finances a worker's daily operating expenses (market stall rent, transport, tools) and the investor earns a micro-return. Creates a direct connection between savers and workers — everyone becomes financially included.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Civic Project Milestone Token
underlyingAsset: Retail civic project milestone investments — Oman
description: Stock Brokers Ltd brokers community civic project tokens — stadium refurbishments, market upgrades, community centres — where each milestone completion triggers token issuance. Retail investors track real-world project progress and earn on completion. Projects must employ local labour and include skills transfer components.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Crop Season Investment Token
description: Through Stock Brokers Ltd, urban salary earners and diaspora investors in Oman finance rural crop seasons. Each token represents a share of a diversified portfolio of seasonal crop loans to verified smallholder farmers. Harvest repayments generate investor returns. Connecting urban capital to rural food production reduces both food insecurity and rural unemployment.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd High-Street SME Token
underlyingAsset: Local SME investment for all — Oman
description: Stock Brokers Ltd tokenises neighbourhood small businesses — the corner store, the barbershop, the school uniform tailor — and makes them available for investment on mobile devices. Investors own a share of Oman's local economy. SMEs gain affordable working capital. Jobs are created and preserved in every community where Stock Brokers Ltd operates.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Community Wealth ETF Token
description: Stock Brokers Ltd offers a community wealth ETF that tracks all tokenised asset classes in Oman, weighted to maximise financial inclusion impact. 30% SME and labor tokens, 30% agriculture, 20% real estate, 20% bonds and equities. Ordinary investors gain professional portfolio management previously available only to high-net-worth individuals.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Mobile Equity Token
description: Stock Brokers Ltd enables any mobile phone user in Oman to buy fractional shares in listed companies. Starting from the cost of a text message, every citizen becomes a shareholder. Stock Brokers Ltd handles all settlement, custody and dividends automatically. Creates a nation of informed investors and reduces dependence on manual labour income alone.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Savings Bond Token
underlyingAsset: Accessible savings bonds for all income levels — Oman
description: Stock Brokers Ltd distributes government and corporate savings bonds in Oman via mobile-accessible fractional tokens. Market traders, teachers, nurses and factory workers can invest their daily or weekly savings into government-guaranteed instruments. Regular coupon payments provide stable supplementary income for households.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Youth Investment Token
description: Stock Brokers Ltd issues youth financial inclusion tokens for investors under 35 in Oman. Proceeds go into a youth enterprise fund supporting school-leaver startups, apprenticeships and vocational training programmes. Token holders vote on fund allocations. Creates jobs while teaching young people how capital markets work.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Retail Mining Token
underlyingAsset: Retail access to mineral investment — Oman
description: Stock Brokers Ltd makes mineral investment accessible to all Oman citizens. Previously exclusive to large mining companies and foreign investors, copper, cobalt and gold revenue can now be owned in fractions by any citizen. Community mining cooperatives list their output through Stock Brokers Ltd, providing fair prices and eliminating exploitative middlemen.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Rural Farmer Token
description: Through Stock Brokers Ltd, verified smallholder farmer output in Oman becomes a retail investable asset. Urban investors fund rural harvests through AgriPoW tokens; farmers earn investment and build credit history simultaneously. Eliminates hunger-driven distress selling by giving farmers financial security before and after harvest.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Trade Route Token
underlyingAsset: End-to-end trade route supply chain — Oman
description: Stock Brokers Ltd brokers investment in Oman's critical trade supply chains — from mine to port, from farm to supermarket. Each supply chain participant (transporter, warehouse, processor) issues step tokens that investors can fund. Efficient supply chain financing reduces costs, creates stable transport and logistics employment, and improves consumer prices.
regulatoryFramework: Oman Financial Markets Act; Oman Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024
